source_description: Harbor Table at Dusk is a 2.5-hour private dining experience for two to six adults, offered on Fridays and Saturdays throughout the year except 24–31 December. Guests receive a 20-minute boat transfer to the West Pier Dining Room, where a private chef serves a five-course seafood tasting menu with a paired beverage flight. The transfer is included in the 2.5-hour experience. Reservations must be made at least five days in advance, and the experience is subject to suitable boating conditions. Additional beverages are charged separately.
